Messages.Author: Khaleph Alendis
Messages.Body:
At Praxis Montreal last weekend, in a game with the player that dont go
to the final round, a discussion started about the bleeding of a meth
other than the prey.

I know that the discussion in the «Praxis Seizure: Kansas City Results»
thread seem to answer the question, but two of the prince (including
me) present at the tournament had said that we can bleed any meth if
the card has a D on it. So i ask for a clarification :

If i bleed without a card, the only Meth i can bleed is my prey.

If i bleed with the card Legal Manipulations (or other card with only a
D on it), the only Meth i can bleed is my prey.

If i bleed with the card Kindred Spirits (or other card with similar
text), i can bleed any meth.

Is all that is ok ?

If so, it prove (another time) that the princes are not perfect ;-)

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 22 Jun 2000, Khaleph Alendis wrote:
> If i bleed without a card, the only Meth i can bleed is my prey.

Yes.

> If i bleed with the card Legal Manipulations (or other card with only a
> D on it), the only Meth i can bleed is my prey.

Yes, because it doesn't allow anything else. So the bleed action follows
the basic restriction of being against your prey.

> If i bleed with the card Kindred Spirits (or other card with similar
> text), i can bleed any meth.

Yes.

Another example would be Night Moves, for predator and prey.

> the card has a D on it. So i ask for a clarification :

Assuming no one plays Deflection, etc.:

> If i bleed without a card, the only Meth i can bleed is my prey.

Yes, according to the rulebook. [6.1.1]

> If i bleed with the card Legal Manipulations (or other card with only a
> D on it), the only Meth i can bleed is my prey.

Yes, according to the rulebook. [6.1.6]

> If i bleed with the card Kindred Spirits (or other card with similar
> text), i can bleed any meth.

Yes, according to the rulebook. [6.1.6], [1.4]
